import pytest

from dataclasses import dataclass
from enum import Enum
import uuid

class OrderState(Enum):
    PENDING = "pending"
    RESERVED = "reserved"
    PAID = "paid"
    CONFIRMED = "confirmed"
    FAILED = "failed"

class TestOrder:

def test_complete_order_flow(services, isolated_order):

    seed_inventory(isolated_order.items)
    configure_payment_to_fail()
    
    result = submit_order(isolated_order)
    
    assert result.state == OrderState.FAILED
    assert inventory_was_unreserved(isolated_order.items)  # Compensation verified!

# === THEOREM 5: Idempotency ===
def test_duplicate_order_submission_is_idempotent(services, isolated_order):
    """Submitting twice must not charge twice. Obviously."""
    seed_inventory(isolated_order.items)

    result2 = submit_order(isolated_order)  # Same order ID
    
    assert result1.id == result2.id
    assert get_payment_count(isolated_order.id) == 1
